speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you have been fatigued, experiencing flank pain, and developing a fever recently after finishing antibiotic treatment for acute sinusitis. To help me pinpoint the cause of these new symptoms, have you noticed any changes in the color, clarity, or amount of your urine, or are you experiencing pain when urinating?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Pyelonephritis (likely post-AKI or due to inadequate prior coverage).

Thank you for confirming your symptoms; since your urine characteristics and dysuria were not mentioned, I need to urgently request a Urinalysis and Urine Culture to confirm infection and identify the pathogen. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis, Urine_Culture
